cause_quote: The new settings branch used `: html` followed by `<div class="plugins-toolbar">` in place of a page heading, then rendered `renderSkillLibrary(this.library)` separately inside the settings workspace.
user_saw: The Skills settings page had no title or description, and its four primary actions appeared in two separate rows.
summary: The fix adds the shared Skills settings header and groups Search skills, Workshop, Create skill, and Import skill in one toolbar that wraps on narrow screens.
reasoning: I checked the route and rendering diffs for #143758 and confirmed that it introduced `/settings/skills` as a dedicated settings surface. The same diff gave that surface a navigation toolbar without a heading and rendered the existing creation and import controls separately, so the layout defect shipped with the page.
